capability: Check a suggested package exists before install
title: Nothing fake gets past the door.

hook.picture: Close on the whale dropping a card labelled with a package name onto the line, quick and confident.
hook.words: It even wrote the install line.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The AI added a package that does not even exist.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: cards are named from memory and dropped straight onto the line; nothing looks inside before they land. Three-times device: three cards drop in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time one comes up hollow at the pod.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: It sounds right, so nobody checks.

stakes.body: A build breaks at best. At worst, someone registers that fake name with bad code inside.

solution_hint: Check every package is real first.

metaphor.body: Each package is a card that must pass a door on the line before the pod opens it; the door looks inside, and a hollow card never gets through.

steps.picture: A gate rises on the line in front of the pod; each package card must pass through it.
steps.words: Check every package is real first.

steps.picture: A full card passes; the gate glows; a ring on its tab shows it was looked up.
A hollow card reaches the gate; it closes, and the card is refused and drops away before the pod.
steps.words: Not real? It never reaches the build.

steps.picture: Three more cards pass; the post gets its name.
steps.words: That check at the door: a gate.

real_case.claim: The craft README: "~19.7% of AI-suggested packages don't" exist (attributed to USENIX Security 2025); its supply-chain-hygiene skill checks that dependencies exist.

honest_limit.picture: A full, real card passes the gate cleanly, but inside its lines there is a rust smudge: a real package with bad code inside.
honest_limit.words: A real package can still be bad.

not_this.body: Real is not the same as safe.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The pod opens every card it receives and each one is full; behind the gate a small pile of hollow cards lies where they were stopped.
ending_pattern.callback: The hollow card the pod opened in bar 2 now lies behind the gate, never reaching it.

end_belief.body: Check the name exists before you install.
